observations: body L1-L15: the first figure stands on the left of these lines and is redrawn from the print: the eccentric AK about O (radius 82.2 pt) and the epicycle about Q (radius 30.6 pt), circles fitted to the print; the diameter AK; the lines RQE and PQN, which meet 1.1 pt from the centre of the epicycle and 0.4 pt from the eccentric; the dashed line from S on the eccentric to E, drawn dash by dash; dots at O, E and N; the two feathered arrows of the motions, traced as filled outlines; the letters, in a lighter italic than those of the second figure. On the figure AEQ = 28.98° is twice AES = 14.49°, and NQE = 5.10° against QEA × EN : NA = 5.06°; EO and EN measure 21.2 and 21.9 pt against EA = 103.4 pt, where Ptolemy's 10p 19′ : 60p would give 17.8 pt.
body L7, L16: L7 names the angle «RPQ», at P, which is not small; the angle meant is RQP at the centre of the epicycle, which L16 sets equal to NQE, the «portio»; kept as printed.

body L5, L12, L14: the hyphens of «prove-» and «distantia-» print as short marks (1.2 and 1.8 pt). The minus signs of «QEA — QNA» and «NA — EA» (L14) are printed as long dashes (10.0 and 9.7 pt) and set as minus signs; in the second «EA» and the last «NA» of L14 the E and the N print broken.

body L13-L18: for the small angles under which the arc QA is seen from E and N, QEA : QNA = NA : EA; NQE = QEA − QNA, the exterior angle at E of the triangle QNE; NA − EA = EN. With EA = 60p and EN = 10p 19′, NA = 70p 19′, and 10p 19′ × 2 = 20p 38′.

body L21-L22: 20p 38′ : 70p 19′ = 0,29343; 1/6 + 1/8 = 7/24 = 0,291667, which the print gives as 0,2916. «al–Battānī» (L21) is letter-spaced, with a long dash (5.0 pt); the dash before «Schiaparelli» measures 9.8 pt, and a heavy bracket closes the addition begun on p. 273, L27.

body L23-L25, L39: the dash after «c)» measures 9.8 pt and «3–9» has a long dash (4.1 pt); the dash before «Satis» (L24) measures 10.0 pt. A heavy bracket opens Schiaparelli's addition in L24; it goes on to p. 275. «al-» (L24) is letter-spaced, with a hyphen (3.0 pt), and «–Battānī» (L25) begins with a long dash (5.0 pt); «Al–Battānī» (L39) has a long dash (5.1 pt).

body L24-L40: the second figure stands on the right of these lines and is redrawn from the print: the epicycle about C (radius 41.7 pt); the edges of the angles AEB and aEb, drawn from the circle to E, which they reach within 0.6 pt, the angles hatched with horizontal lines at their printed heights (107 and 106 lines, 0.6 pt thick); the line from E touching the epicycle at α and β (C lies 42.0 pt from it), produced beyond the circle as printed; the bold italic letters, β in a lighter italic. On the figure CEa = 8.7° and the greatest equation CEα = 14.8°, in the ratio 3 : 5 of the text; the arcs AB and ab measure 20.2° and 18.0°, the angles AEB and aEb 4.1° and 2.8°.
notes_left L1-L2: Almagest VI, 5, where Ptolemy has 7° 24′ (p. 96, note 2), treats the ecliptic limits. The print sets no rule between the two columns of the notes.
notes_right L2: the dash before «Schiaparelli» measures 7.4 pt.
